opening.argument: The video presents natural stone mosaics as ordinary retail merchandise, with boxes and displayed samples shown in a tile showroom. The speaker describes a limited stock campaign, stating that it continues “until everything is sold out, as long as the stock is good,” and gives a straightforward retail price of between one and three euros per piece. These are conventional product-promotion details tied to physical mosaic products and their showroom sale. The apparent sales cues do not concern investment, credentials, unusual payment, or any other deceptive mechanism. The evidence therefore supports treating the presentation as a routine offer of merchandise, while making no claim beyond the stated products, pricing, and stock limitation.
